```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

# Purpose and hypothesis (stated before running)

ARIMAX is fitted separately for every store, so each model learns only from
that store's own history. LightGBM and XGBoost are pooled: one model learns
from all 50 stores at once. The global-versus-local argument
(Montero-Manso and Hyndman, 2021) implies that pooling matters most when each
series is short.

**Hypothesis.** As the training history shrinks from the full sample to
12, 6 and 3 months, ARIMAX's RMSE rises faster than LightGBM's, so the
LightGBM-minus-ARIMAX difference moves in favour of LightGBM.

**What would contradict it.** ARIMAX keeping pace with, or improving
relative to, LightGBM as the window shrinks. The result is reported either way.

**Design rules fixed in advance.**

* Same 50 stores (same eligibility rule and seed as `rossmann_arimax.Rmd`),
  same origins (8 May and 19 June 2015), same 42-day horizon, same test rows.
* Every model sees the same training window. Only the window length changes.
* The annual sine/cosine pair cannot be estimated from less than one year of
  data, so for the 3- and 6-month windows it is removed from **all** models.
  The 12-month window keeps it, as does the full-history run.
* ARIMA search, tree settings and early stopping are unchanged.

# 1. Packages and data

```{r packages}
library(data.table)
library(forecast)
library(lightgbm)
library(xgboost)

data_dirs <- c(".", "..", "Data/rossmann-store-sales", "../Data/rossmann-store-sales")
DATA_DIR  <- data_dirs[file.exists(file.path(data_dirs, "train.csv"))][1]
if (is.na(DATA_DIR)) stop("train.csv not found in: ", paste(data_dirs, collapse = ", "))
if (!file.exists("thesis_tables/arimax_comparison.csv"))
  stop("Knit rossmann_arimax.Rmd first: thesis_tables/arimax_comparison.csv is missing.")

SEED      <- 230923
BOOT_SEED <- 230925
H         <- 42
N_CORES   <- max(1, min(4, parallel::detectCores() - 1))
ORIGINS   <- as.Date(c("2015-05-08", "2015-06-19"))
WINDOWS   <- c("3 months" = 91L, "6 months" = 182L, "12 months" = 364L)

dir.create("thesis_tables",    showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("rossmann_outputs", showWarnings = FALSE)

raw <- fread(file.path(DATA_DIR, "train.csv"))
raw[, Date := as.Date(Date)]
stores <- fread(file.path(DATA_DIR, "store.csv"))
```

# 2. Same 50 stores as the main ARIMAX check

```{r sample}
set.seed(SEED)
eligible <- raw[Date <= ORIGINS[1], .(n = .N, first = min(Date)), by = Store]
full_len <- as.integer(ORIGINS[1] - as.Date("2013-01-01")) + 1
eligible <- eligible[n == full_len & first == as.Date("2013-01-01")]
pool <- merge(eligible, stores[, .(Store, StoreType)], by = "Store")
allocation <- c(a = 27L, b = 1L, c = 7L, d = 15L)
ids <- unlist(lapply(names(allocation), function(k)
  sample(sort(pool[StoreType == k, Store]), allocation[[k]])))

# Must be the same stores as in rossmann_arimax.Rmd.
if (file.exists("rossmann_outputs/arimax_sample.csv")) {
  prev <- fread("rossmann_outputs/arimax_sample.csv")$Store
  stopifnot(setequal(prev, ids))
  cat("Store sample matches rossmann_arimax.Rmd\n")
}
```

# 3. Covariates

```{r covariates}
raw <- raw[Store %in% ids][order(Store, Date)]
raw[, DOW := factor(as.integer(format(Date, "%u")), levels = 1:7)]
raw[, day := as.numeric(Date - as.Date("2013-01-01")) / 365.25]
raw[, annual_sin := sin(2 * pi * day)]
raw[, annual_cos := cos(2 * pi * day)]
raw[, holiday := as.integer(StateHoliday != "0")]

X_full <- model.matrix(~ DOW * Promo + SchoolHoliday + holiday + Open +
                         annual_sin + annual_cos + day, raw)[, -1, drop = FALSE]
colnames(X_full) <- make.names(colnames(X_full))
# Design rule: no annual terms when the window is shorter than a year.
X_for <- function(days) {
  if (days < 364) X_full[, !colnames(X_full) %in% c("annual_sin", "annual_cos"), drop = FALSE]
  else X_full
}
storex <- model.matrix(~ factor(Store) - 1, raw)
```

# 4. Models

```{r fns}
predict_store <- function(s, origin, days, X) {
  ix <- which(raw$Store == s & raw$Date <= origin & raw$Date > origin - days)
  it <- which(raw$Store == s & raw$Date > origin & raw$Date <= origin + H)
  xx <- X[ix, , drop = FALSE]
  qq <- qr(cbind(Intercept = 1, xx))
  keep <- sort(qq$pivot[seq_len(qq$rank)]); keep <- keep[keep > 1] - 1L
  fit <- auto.arima(ts(raw$Sales[ix], frequency = 7), xreg = xx[, keep, drop = FALSE],
                    seasonal = TRUE, stepwise = TRUE, approximation = TRUE,
                    max.p = 3, max.q = 3, max.P = 1, max.Q = 1, max.order = 5)
  data.table(Store = s, Date = raw$Date[it], Sales = raw$Sales[it], Open = raw$Open[it],
             Prediction = as.numeric(forecast(fit, xreg = X[it, keep, drop = FALSE],
                                              h = length(it))$mean))
}
xgb_fit_valid <- function(params, dtrain, dvalid) {
  a <- list(params = params, data = dtrain, nrounds = 1200,
            early_stopping_rounds = 50, verbose = 0)
  if ("evals" %in% names(formals(xgb.train))) a$evals <- list(valid = dvalid)
  else a$watchlist <- list(valid = dvalid)
  do.call(xgb.train, a)
}
xgb_best <- function(fit) {
  b <- tryCatch(as.integer(fit$best_iteration), error = function(e) integer())
  if (!length(b) || is.na(b)) b <- as.integer(xgb.attr(fit, "best_iteration")) + 1L
  b
}
```

```{r fits, cache=TRUE}
out <- list()
for (w in names(WINDOWS)) for (k in seq_along(ORIGINS)) {
  days <- WINDOWS[[w]]; origin <- ORIGINS[k]; X <- X_for(days)
  t0 <- Sys.time()

  # ARIMAX, one model per store. A failed store stops the knit.
  fits <- parallel::mclapply(ids, function(s)
    tryCatch(predict_store(s, origin, days, X),
             error = function(e) conditionMessage(e)), mc.cores = N_CORES)
  bad <- !vapply(fits, is.data.table, logical(1))
  if (any(bad)) { print(fits[bad]); stop("ARIMAX failed for a store") }
  arimax_min <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "mins"))
  pp <- rbindlist(fits); pp[, Model := "ARIMAX"]
  res <- list(pp)

  # Pooled trees on the same window, store indicators added.
  ix <- which(raw$Date <= origin & raw$Date > origin - days)
  it <- which(raw$Date > origin & raw$Date <= origin + H)
  xx <- cbind(X, storex); trainx <- xx[ix, , drop = FALSE]; yy <- raw$Sales[ix]
  vv <- which(raw$Date[ix] > origin - H); tt <- setdiff(seq_along(ix), vv)

  lp_par <- list(objective = "regression", metric = "rmse", num_leaves = 31,
                 learning_rate = .05, min_data_in_leaf = 20, num_threads = 4,
                 seed = SEED, verbosity = -1, deterministic = TRUE, force_col_wise = TRUE)
  lv <- lgb.train(lp_par, lgb.Dataset(trainx[tt, ], label = yy[tt]), nrounds = 1200,
                  valids = list(valid = lgb.Dataset(trainx[vv, ], label = yy[vv])),
                  early_stopping_rounds = 50, verbose = -1)
  lfit <- lgb.train(lp_par, lgb.Dataset(trainx, label = yy), nrounds = lv$best_iter, verbose = -1)

  xp_par <- list(objective = "reg:squarederror", eta = .05, max_depth = 6, nthread = 4, seed = SEED)
  xv <- xgb_fit_valid(xp_par, xgb.DMatrix(trainx[tt, ], label = yy[tt]),
                      xgb.DMatrix(trainx[vv, ], label = yy[vv]))
  xfit <- xgb.train(xp_par, xgb.DMatrix(trainx, label = yy), nrounds = xgb_best(xv), verbose = 0)

  base <- raw[it, .(Store, Date, Sales, Open)]
  res[[2]] <- copy(base)[, `:=`(Prediction = predict(lfit, xx[it, , drop = FALSE]), Model = "LightGBM")]
  res[[3]] <- copy(base)[, `:=`(Prediction = predict(xfit, xgb.DMatrix(xx[it, , drop = FALSE])), Model = "XGBoost")]

  # Store-DOW baseline on the same window.
  bm <- raw[Date <= origin & Date > origin - days & Open == 1 & Sales > 0,
            .(Prediction = mean(Sales)), by = .(Store, DOW)]
  sd <- copy(base)[, DOW := raw$DOW[it]]
  sd <- merge(sd, bm, by = c("Store", "DOW"), all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)[, DOW := NULL]
  res[[4]] <- sd[, Model := "Store-DOW"]

  r <- rbindlist(res, use.names = TRUE)
  r[, `:=`(Origin = origin, Window = w, ARIMAX_minutes = round(arimax_min, 1))]
  out[[length(out) + 1]] <- r
  cat(w, as.character(origin), "done; ARIMAX took", round(arimax_min, 1), "min\n")
}
allpred <- rbindlist(out, use.names = TRUE)
```

# 5. Accuracy by training window

Scored on the same open, positive-sales store-days as the main check. The
full-history rows are read from `thesis_tables/arimax_comparison.csv`.

```{r accuracy}
fwrite(allpred, "rossmann_outputs/arimax_history_predictions.csv")
pred <- allpred[Open == 1 & Sales > 0]
stopifnot(!anyNA(pred$Prediction))
stopifnot(all(pred[, .(same = uniqueN(.SD[, .N, by = Model]$N) == 1), by = .(Origin, Window)]$same))

res <- pred[, .(RMSE = sqrt(mean((Sales - Prediction)^2)),
                MAE = mean(abs(Sales - Prediction)), N = .N),
            by = .(Origin, Window, Model)]
full <- fread("thesis_tables/arimax_comparison.csv")[Model %in% unique(res$Model)]
full <- full[, .(Origin = as.Date(Origin), Window = "Full history", Model, RMSE, MAE, N)]
res <- rbind(res, full)
res[, Window := factor(Window, levels = c("3 months", "6 months", "12 months", "Full history"))]
setorder(res, Origin, Window, RMSE)
fwrite(res, "thesis_tables/arimax_history.csv")
dcast(res, Origin + Window ~ Model, value.var = "RMSE")[, lapply(.SD, function(x)
  if (is.numeric(x)) round(x) else x)]
```

ARIMAX run time per window (minutes, 50 stores):

```{r timing}
unique(allpred[, .(Origin, Window, ARIMAX_minutes)])
```

# 6. LightGBM vs ARIMAX: paired block-bootstrap intervals

Same procedure as the main check: LightGBM MSE minus ARIMAX MSE, circular
seven-day blocks of daily pooled squared losses, 2000 resamples. Negative
values favour LightGBM.

```{r bootstrap}
daily <- pred[, .(SSE = sum((Sales - Prediction)^2), N = .N), by = .(Origin, Window, Model, Date)]
set.seed(BOOT_SEED)
ci <- list()
for (w in names(WINDOWS)) for (k in seq_along(ORIGINS)) {
  o <- ORIGINS[k]
  a <- daily[Origin == o & Window == w & Model == "ARIMAX"][order(Date)]
  b <- daily[Origin == o & Window == w & Model == "LightGBM"][order(Date)]
  stopifnot(identical(a$Date, b$Date), identical(a$N, b$N), nrow(a) == H)
  boot <- replicate(2000, {
    j <- unlist(lapply(sample.int(H, H / 7, TRUE), function(s) ((s - 1 + 0:6) %% H) + 1))
    sum(b$SSE[j] - a$SSE[j]) / sum(a$N[j])
  })
  q <- quantile(boot, c(.025, .975))
  ci[[length(ci) + 1]] <- data.table(Origin = o, Window = w,
    Comparison = "LightGBM minus ARIMAX",
    MSE_difference = sum(b$SSE - a$SSE) / sum(a$N), Lower = q[1], Upper = q[2])
}
ci <- rbindlist(ci)
# Full-history interval from the main check, for the same comparison.
fci <- fread("thesis_tables/arimax_uncertainty.csv")[Comparison == "LightGBM minus ARIMAX"]
# The main file stores comparator minus ARIMAX, i.e. the same sign convention.
fci <- fci[, .(Origin = as.Date(Origin), Window = "Full history", Comparison,
               MSE_difference, Lower, Upper)]
ci <- rbind(ci, fci)
fwrite(ci, "thesis_tables/arimax_history_ci.csv")
ci[, Reading := fifelse(Upper < 0, "favours LightGBM",
                fifelse(Lower > 0, "favours ARIMAX", "includes zero"))]
ci
```

# 7. Figure

```{r figure, fig.width=8, fig.height=4}
plot_hist <- function() {
  par(mfrow = c(1, 2), mar = c(4, 4, 2, 1))
  cols <- c(ARIMAX = "#b2182b", LightGBM = "#2166ac", XGBoost = "#67a9cf", `Store-DOW` = "grey50")
  for (o in as.character(ORIGINS)) {
    d <- res[as.character(Origin) == o]
    plot(NA, xlim = c(1, 4), ylim = range(res$RMSE), xaxt = "n",
         xlab = "Training history", ylab = "RMSE (EUR)", main = paste("Origin", o))
    axis(1, at = 1:4, labels = c("3m", "6m", "12m", "Full"))
    for (m in names(cols)) {
      z <- d[Model == m][order(Window)]
      lines(as.integer(z$Window), z$RMSE, type = "b", pch = 19, col = cols[[m]], lwd = 2)
    }
    if (o == as.character(ORIGINS[1]))
      legend("topright", names(cols), col = cols, lwd = 2, pch = 19, bty = "n", cex = .8)
  }
}
plot_hist()
pdf("rossmann_outputs/fig_arimax_history.pdf", width = 8, height = 4); plot_hist(); invisible(dev.off())
```

# 8. Reading the result

Compare the LightGBM-minus-ARIMAX intervals from "Full history" down to
"3 months". The hypothesis is supported if they move below zero (towards
LightGBM) as the window shrinks, and contradicted if they stay at or above
zero.

```{r session}
sessionInfo()
```
